# Comandos y la primera línea que responde el catcher (HELLO, CFG?, SET freq y MEAS). Cubre todos los !ERR que emite el firmware.
HELLO	{"cmd":"HELLO","reply":"#HELLO fw=0.6.0 proto=2 role=catcher radio=SX1262 id=C3F01A"}
CFG?	{"cmd":"CFG?","reply":"#CFG freq=915.800 bw=250 sf=10 cr=5"}
SET freq=910.525	{"cmd":"SET","key":"freq","reply":"#OK freq=910.525"}
SET freq=914	{"cmd":"SET","key":"freq","reply":"#OK freq=914"}
SET freq=900	{"cmd":"SET","key":"freq","error":"range","reply":"!ERR range freq 902.000-928.000"}
SET freq=x	{"cmd":"SET","key":"freq","error":"syntax","reply":"!ERR syntax"}
SET freq	{"cmd":"SET","error":"syntax","reply":"!ERR syntax"}
SET sf=7	{"cmd":"SET","key":"sf","error":"unknown","reply":"!ERR unknown sf"}
BOGUS	{"cmd":"BOGUS","error":"unknown","reply":"!ERR unknown"}
PING	{"cmd":"PING","error":"unknown","reply":"!ERR unknown"}
MEAS x	{"cmd":"MEAS","error":"syntax","reply":"!ERR syntax"}
MEAS 15	{"cmd":"MEAS","error":"range","reply":"!ERR range meas 16-256"}
MEAS 257	{"cmd":"MEAS","error":"range","reply":"!ERR range meas 16-256"}
